# n-noodles

> Declarative SVG noodle canvas. Children declare ports and the element handles the SVG overlay, coordinate system, and stacking context.

**Class:** `NNoodles`

**ARIA role:** `none`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `editable` | `boolean` |  | Allow interactive creation/deletion of connections |
| `color` | `string` |  | Noodle stroke color (default accent) |
| `stroke-width` | `number` |  | Stroke width in px (default 2) |
| `tension` | `number` |  | Bezier control point distance 0-1 (default 0.5) |
| `show-ports` | `boolean` |  | Show port indicator dots (defaults to editable state) |
| `port-size` | `number` |  | Port dot size in px (default 10) |
| `curve` | `enum` |  | Curve style (default bezier) |
| `animated` | `boolean` |  | Flowing dash animation on noodles |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disable the controller |
